subject: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Leah Morris <leah.morris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal

Team / Leah —

Attaching the mid-quarter risk register and a refreshed mutual action plan for the Acme Health renewal (attachments). High level status: we are tracking green on the integration workstream but amber on the latency SLO and on audit evidence delivery. I want to surface the risks that will impact our Q3 objective to "Deliver production-grade inference for Acme in their region with <200ms p95 and SOC2 evidence available" and propose a small re-scope to preserve the renewal timeline.

Key points:
- Integration: baseline connector work is on schedule; internal integration tests begin 7/12.
- Latency SLO: p95 target currently set at 120ms; realistic window (given current model + quantization experiments) is 140–160ms without a hardware bump.
- Compliance: Acme needs SOC2 artifacts and logs for their audit week starting 8/16; our current SOC packaging ETA ~8/10. Procurement also needs a final PO and signature.

Requests / asks:
1) Marcus — can you confirm whether we can meet 140ms p95 with the current quantized model by 7/23, or do we need a dedicated node pool?
2) Lauren — please coordinate with CS to lock an integration lead from Acme for test data and runbook access.
3) Leah / Procurement — can you confirm PO timing and whether DocuSign is required by 7/20?

Proposed temporary re-scope (so we can keep go-live in early August): drop aggressive 120ms p95 target to 140ms p95 for the first week of production, with a committed optimization plan to 120ms by 9/1.

Next steps in the risk register (sheet tab): owners, mitigation, and rollback plan.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_OKR_risk_register.xlsx (spreadsheet), MAP_AcmeHealth_v2.pdf (mutual action plan)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Leah Morris <leah.morris@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal

Hannah —

Thanks, flagged. Quick reality check: our perf runs on the quantized variant show median latency improvements but tail is still noisy at longer sequences. I can push an aggressive tuning sprint, but we have two levers:

- software-only (quantization + kernel tweaks) — ETA 7/23 for a conservative p95 ~145–155ms across 1k reqs/s synthetic load
- capacity (add a small dedicated node pool with A100s) — ETA 7/12 to provision, but cost + procurement for Dedicated may push commercial conversation.

If leadership wants to ensure <140ms p95 by go-live, we need the dedicated pool. Otherwise I recommend the temporary 140ms p95 in prod and then follow-up optimization.

I'll attach abbreviated latency test notes to the risk sheet.

Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Leah Morris <leah.morris@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal

Thanks Marcus — that matches my read.

Decision proposal: we adopt the scoped rollback approach so Acme can onboard early in August:
- Go-live SLO: p95 = 140ms for first two weeks.
- Engineering commitment: Marcus to run the quantization sprint and provide a nightly perf summary; escalate to dedicated pool if nightly perf sits >155ms after 7/20.
- Commercial: Lauren to offer a short-term dedicated burst add-on (non-committed) pricing for Acme if they want faster tails at go-live.

Leah — would you be comfortable with a 140ms p95 ramp at first, with a written roadmap to 120ms by 9/1? That gives us time to finalize SOC packaging without delaying their onboarding.

On procurement: if DocuSign is required by your legal team, we can get the contract over by 7/15 once procurement confirms PO terms.

Hannah

From: Leah Morris <leah.morris@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal

Hannah / team —

Appreciate the transparency. From Acme's side:
- SOC2 artifacts: legal/audit need access to logs and the controls summary no later than 8/10; can you confirm the delivery date on evidence?
- Latency: the 140ms ramp is acceptable provided the roadmap to 120ms is documented and we have a rollback plan if integration causes production instability.
- PO / DocuSign: procurement will need a clean SOW and PO by 7/20. We use DocuSign; procurement@acmehealth.com will expect a DocuSign envelope.

Can we schedule a 30-min runbook readout this week to align owners? Lauren — can you coordinate and propose 3 time slots?

Thanks,
Leah Morris
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Leah Morris <leah.morris@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal

Leah / team —

I'll coordinate the runbook readout. Quick dependency ask: we need an Acme test lead who can drop sanitized sample payloads and run the end-to-end smoke tests the week of 7/12. Without test data we can't validate edge cases and the latency tail.

Proposed slots for a 30-min readout (Pacific): Thu 7/8 10:00–10:30, Thu 7/8 15:00–15:30, Fri 7/9 09:00–09:30. Please pick one and I'll send calendar invite + a shared runbook (integration_runbook.md).

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Leah Morris <leah.morris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR status + risk register — Acme Health renewal

Summary + actions (finalizing for leadership/QBR notes):

Agreed decisions:
- Temporary prod SLO: p95 = 140ms for first two weeks of go-live.
- Optimization runway: target 120ms p95 by 2026-09-01 (Marcus owner).
- Compliance deliverable: SOC2 artifacts targeted for delivery by 2026-08-10 (Compliance & Security owner - internal).

Action items:
- Marcus: produce nightly perf recap (by 23:59 PDT) starting 7/12 and escalate if nightly p95 > 155ms after 7/20.
- Lauren: schedule runbook readout (send invite + runbook) and confirm Acme test lead by 7/9.
- Procurement (Acme): confirm PO requirement and DocuSign envelope by 7/20.
- Hannah: update QBR slide with risk register and the scoped SLO change; circulate to execs by 7/8.

Attachments: updated Q3_OKR_risk_register.xlsx (owners + mitigation column populated).

I'll follow up after the runbook readout to update the risk status and any escalation to leadership.

Thanks —
Hannah
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
